full_judgment: 12. The respondent No. 1 contested the Rule by filing an affidavit-in-opposition contending inter-alia that the burden of proof lies upon the petitioner. The Uttara Model Town, Sector No. 5, Road No, 6 and plot No. 30 was allotted in favour of the petitioner and during delivery of possession an extra portion of land measuring 1 katha 7 chattaks and 13 square feet was also allotted in favour of the petitioner vide memo No. 2774 dated 6-8-1990, however, subsequently the extra allotment was cancelled through Genera Board Meeting when it revealed that initial report of Surveyors and Kanongoos are wrong, and incorrect since there is no extra land for this purpose vide Board Meeting No. 6 of 2003.
